faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything You Need to Know About Ramadan Tent Rentals in Dubai
faq.intro: At Tent Now, we've spent 30 years answering every question imaginable about Ramadan setups. We've compiled the most common ones here, providing clear, expert answers that reflect our deep knowledge of UAE regulations, climate challenges, and cultural expectations.

when.q: When is Ramadan 2026 in the UAE?
when.a: Ramadan 2026 is expected to commence on or around February 17th, 2026. The exact date is subject to the moon sighting, but it is crucial to begin planning your setup well in advance.

howEarly.q: How early should I book my Ramadan tent or Majlis?
howEarly.a: Immediately. With Ramadan starting in mid-February 2026, the peak booking season is already underway. Early booking ensures you secure your preferred dates, designs, and the best possible pricing.

difference.q: What is the difference between an Iftar tent, a Suhoor tent, and a general Ramadan Majlis?
difference.a: Iftar Tents focus on efficient flow for buffet service and large seating capacity. Suhoor Tents are more relaxed, intimate, and lounge-like with softer lighting. A general Majlis is a versatile space balancing comfort with elegance for hosting throughout the Holy Month.

permits.q: What permits do I need to set up a Ramadan tent in Dubai?
permits.a: Most common approvals are required from Dubai Civil Defense (fire/safety) and Dubai Municipality (hygiene/food). Our experienced team handles all permitting on your behalf.

cooling.q: Do I still need powerful air conditioning in February?
cooling.a: Yes. While February is cooler, humidity and guest occupancy levels can cause temperatures to rise quickly. Our precise AC tonnage calculations ensure a consistently crisp environment.

custom.q: Can you create a completely custom-designed Majlis?
custom.a: Customization is our hallmark. Our in-house design team can create a bespoke concept exclusively for you, matching your specific vision or brand guidelines.

faq.ctaBody: Ramadan planning involves many details. Our team of experts is ready to provide personalized guidance for your unique 2026 requirements.

moonSighting.question: How is the Ramadan start date confirmed in UAE?
moonSighting.answer: The UAE Moon Sighting Committee, composed of religious scholars and astronomers, meets on the 29th of Sha'ban to sight the crescent moon. If sighted, Ramadan begins the next day. If not, Sha'ban completes 30 days, and Ramadan starts the following day. The official announcement is made after sunset on the sighting day.

workHours.question: What are the work hours during Ramadan in UAE?
workHours.answer: Both public and private sector working hours are reduced during Ramadan. Typically, work hours are shortened by 2 hours per day. Private sector companies often operate from 9 AM to 3 PM, while government offices may have different schedules. This applies to all employees, whether fasting or not.

tourists.question: What should tourists and non-fasting residents know?
tourists.answer: While UAE is tolerant and welcoming, respect for those fasting is expected. Avoid eating, drinking, or smoking in public during fasting hours (sunrise to sunset). Most malls and hotels have designated areas for dining. Dress modestly (shoulders and knees covered), keep music at respectful levels, and note that many restaurants are closed until Iftar time.

booking.question: When should I book Ramadan tent rentals for 2026?
booking.answer: Popular dates and premium setups book 2-3 months in advance. For corporate events, government Iftars, or large family gatherings requiring permits and customization, we recommend booking by December 2025 or early January 2026. Last-minute bookings (February) are possible but have limited availability and options.
